description: Run the Marxan optimiser on Biohotspot's planning data (Exmouth Gulf, Western Australia, for now): the cheapest set of planning squares that meets every habitat target. `polygon` protects the squares mostly inside it (unless `protect` is given); the other settings change targets, compactness and what stays open. Takes a few seconds; returns the summary, each habitat's result and the best solution. Nothing is saved: use save_scenario and run_scenario to keep a run in a project.

area_target_pct.description: Also cover this % of the planning area

blm.description: Boundary length modifier: higher gives more compact reserves (default 1000)

protect.description: Planning-square ids always included (understand_area returns an area's as `pus`)

target_pct.description: One target for every habitat, in % of its total (instead of the standard targets)

target_scale.description: Multiply the standard habitat targets, 0-20 (default 1; 0.5 = half)

name: simulate
title: Run the protection options (Marxan)
